_doc: Ground control and fitted transform for Sanborn Map Company, Chicago vol. 3 (1911), sheet 27: E. 18th to E. 20th St., S. Michigan Av. to the alley behind Indiana Av.. GENERATED by tools/georef_prairie_1904.py from the picks written in that tool and the modern control in data/traces/prairie_1904_control.json -- do not hand-edit; re-run the tool. Pixel coordinates are on the committed raster named below. T-1250.
control_source: tied to sanborn_1911_v3_sheet_20 and sanborn_1911_v3_sheet_28 (T-3150): each control point is a crossing this sheet shares with a neighbour, at the position that neighbour's fit gives it. Modern control (data/traces/prairie_1904_control.json, OpenStreetMap, ODbL) enters only through those fits.
pick_method: as sheet 20: each line is the peak of a 5-px-smoothed MEDIAN darkness profile across a window of 300 rows (vertical lines) or 350 columns (horizontal lines); vertical lines at three or four stations along the block, street lines at four stations across both blocks, Michigan-Indiana and Indiana-alley

fit.type: similarity at the sheet's printed scale, TIED to its neighbours (T-3150): scale from the printed bar, rotation and translation by least squares over the crossings it shares with them, pixel -> local ENU of data/datum.json
fit.formula: local_e = a*px + b*py + c ; local_n = d*px + e*py + f ; utm = local + data/datum.json origin
fit.rms_note: rms_component_m is the root mean square over every control COMPONENT used (an easting or a northing); rms_m is its two-dimensional equivalent, the figure comparable with the rms_m other GCP files in this directory state.

printed_scale_bar.note: the printed 'Scale of Feet' under the sheet's lower right, its 50-ft left extension, zero and 150-ft ends, read on a 4x enlargement with a 10-px grid

scale_evidence.note: the printed bar is the sheet's own statement of its scale; the street bands, at the widths the sheet prints on them, test it in both directions, and tools/georef_prairie_1904.py holds every band to tolerance_pct of its printed width

gcps.pixel_note: crossing of the two street centrelines; each centreline is the mean of its two drawn property lines, or one drawn line moved half its printed width
gcps.why_these_components: both, from the neighbouring sheet that draws the same crossing: sanborn_1911_v3_sheet_20 fits it, and its easting and northing here are where that fit puts the crossing of the same two drawn street bands on that sheet (T-3150)

use: For Indiana Avenue's east-face lots from 18th to 20th Street and their corners (T-3150, the street grid's tracer) and the buildings on them (T-3151). Tied to sheets 20 and 28 where it meets them: the three shared crossings agree to 0.67 m RMS (worst component 0.65 m). West of Indiana Avenue -- Michigan Avenue and its lots -- the sheet is read by nothing yet, and nothing ties it there.
